name: Weborado Helper
author: Weborado

sections.description:
Weborado Helper is a practical WordPress plugin that provides essential tools for site administrators to maintain and optimize their WordPress websites. This plugin focuses on version monitoring, security enhancements, and performance recommendations.

Features:

Security Features

  • Displays current WordPress version with update recommendations
  • Shows PHP version with compatibility checks
  • XML-RPC protection to enhance site security
  • Security recommendations based on best practices
  • Easy-to-use security controls

Performance Optimization

  • WordPress performance best practices recommendations
  • Caching strategy guidance

Marketing Guidance

  • Lead generation recommendations for WordPress sites

Weborado Helper is designed to be your essential companion for WordPress site management, providing practical tools and recommendations to keep your site secure, optimized, and effective.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to WordPress admin panel > Plugins > Add New
  3. Click “Upload Plugin” and select the downloaded zip file
  4. Activate the plugin
sections.faq:
What are the minimum requirements?

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • MySQL 5.6 or higher

Is this plugin free to use?

Yes, Weborado Helper is completely free to use. All features are available without any cost.

Does this plugin work with all WordPress themes?

Yes, Weborado Helper is designed to work with all WordPress themes that follow WordPress coding standards. It’s built to be compatible with the latest WordPress version and popular themes.

How do I get support for this plugin?

You can get support through the official WordPress plugin support forum. We actively monitor and respond to all support requests to ensure the best experience for our users.
